# Brett Lechtenberg

> Peak performance coach, keynote speaker, best-selling author, and
> 8th-degree black belt Grandmaster. Founder of Personal Mastery Martial
> Arts (Sandy, Utah) and Total Success AI. Creator of The Master's Edge
> by Brett Lechtenberg — a science-backed peak performance coaching
> methodology built on 30+ years of experience and flow state research.

## Core pages
- [About Brett Lechtenberg](https://www.brettlechtenberg.com/about): Bio, credentials, and story — 30+ years teaching and coaching.
- [The Master's Edge by Brett Lechtenberg](https://www.brettlechtenberg.com/masters-edge): His proprietary peak performance coaching methodology — Mindset Mastery, Skillset Enhancement, Support Structure.
- [Coaching](https://www.brettlechtenberg.com/coaching): Peak performance coaching for leaders, teams, and business owners.
- [Speaking](https://www.brettlechtenberg.com/speaking): Keynote speaking — leadership, flow state, peak performance, and practical AI for business audiences.
- [Books](https://www.brettlechtenberg.com/books): Best-selling author — titles include Bullyproof, Reclaiming the Clock, and the Anti-Bully Program series.
- [Media Kit](https://www.brettlechtenberg.com/media-kit): Speaker one-sheet, bio, photos, and booking information.
- [Contact / Book Brett](https://www.brettlechtenberg.com/book-brett): Booking and contact.

## Related businesses (same Brett Lechtenberg)
- [Personal Mastery Martial Arts](https://www.personalmasterymartialarts.com): His family-owned martial arts & leadership school in Sandy, Utah (since 1996).
